record.original_question: (W. Willems). Conjecture: The sum of squares of the degrees of the irreducible p-Brauer characters of a finite group G is at least the p′-part of |G|. This is known to be true for p = 2(G. Malle, Adv. Math., 380(2021), Paper no. 107609, 15 pp.).

evidence.quote: (W. Willems). Conjecture: The sum of squares of the degrees of the irreducible p-Brauer characters of a finite group G is at least the p′-part of |G|. This is known to be true for p = 2(G. Malle, Adv. Math., 380(2021), Paper no. 107609, 15 pp.).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite group and $p$ a prime. Write $|G| = p^a m$ with $\gcd(m,p)=1$; the integer $m$ is called the $p'$-part of $|G|$. Let $\operatorname{IBr}_p(G)$ denote the set of irreducible $p$-Brauer characters of $G$ (i.e., the irreducible Brauer characters with respect to a $p$-modular system), and for $\varphi \in \operatorname{IBr}_p(G)$ let $\varphi(1)$ be its degree. Prove or disprove the following statement: for every finite group $G$ and every prime $p$,
$$\sum_{\varphi \in \operatorname{IBr}_p(G)} \varphi(1)^2 \;\geq\; |G|_{p'},$$
where $|G|_{p'}$ denotes the $p'$-part of $|G|$.
artifact.category_tag: Brauer character degrees of finite groups
artifact.status_search_result: Willems' conjecture remains open in general. It is known to hold for p-solvable groups (originally by Willems) and for p = 2 (Malle, Adv. Math. 2021), with a reduction to quasi-simple groups by Tong-Viet. No full proof for all primes has appeared.

status_evidence.title: On Willems' conjecture on Brauer character degrees
status_evidence.snippet: Malle proves Willems' conjecture for the prime p = 2 using a reduction to quasi-simple groups.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is proved for p = 2.

status_evidence.title: Problems on Brauer characters (Liu)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Willems' conjecture and partial results, indicating it is open for odd primes in general.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is open for general odd primes.
